EN: I used a RadAway. That should help with the radiation.
ZH: 用了一支消辐宁。这应该有助于缓解我的辐射伤害。

EN: I used a Stimpak. Ahhh. That's better.
ZH: 用了一支治疗针。啊啊啊。我好多了。

EN: Powerful enough to kill an attacker. Barely.
ZH: 威力足以杀死攻击者。勉强。

EN: Serious stopping power in a small package.
ZH: 小身材，大威力。

EN: A decent gun for killing unarmored opponents.
ZH: 一把体面的枪。可以干掉没有护甲的对手。

EN: Just enough to keep you in the fight. And maybe even win.
ZH: 足以让你撑过一场战斗，也许还能赢。

EN: The least dependable handgun in the Wasteland. Good luck.
ZH: 在废土上最不靠谱的手枪。祝你好运。

EN: When someone says “draw,” you say, “die.”
ZH: 当有人说“出招”时，你说“死”。

EN: An ancient design  so effective and reliable, it's still in use after nearly 300 years.
ZH: 一种古老设计，依然有效且可靠，经过了近300年的考验。

EN: The pinnacle. This thing will punch holes in an airship.
ZH: 巅峰之作，这东西甚至能给飞艇打洞。

EN: A perfect classic, improved with updated parts.
ZH: 完美的经典武器，安装了新零件。

EN: The right deterrent for a horde of raiders or supermutants.
ZH: 抵御一群掠夺者或变种人的正确防身武器。

EN: Still intimidating, despite the occasional jam.
ZH: 虽然偶尔卡壳，但威慑力十足。

EN: A technologically advanced weapon of alien origin.
ZH: 一种外星起源的先进技术武器。

EN: This much power is usually reserved for a Zetan cruiser.
ZH: 这么强大的力量是为外星人巡航舰准备的。

EN: Scatter the atoms of your foes... or an entire planet.
ZH: 打散敌人的原子……或者整个星球的。

EN: Specifically enhanced for maximum Earthling annihilation.
ZH: 特别为最大化的地球毁灭而增强制造的。

EN: Left on this planet a long time ago. Still ludicrously powerful.
ZH: 很久以前就被留在这个星球上了。却仍然强大得荒唐。

EN: Probably belonged to an alien officer, who made some... tweaks.
ZH: 可能是一个外星人军官，他做了一些……调整。

EN: A technologically advanced weapon of alien origin, but bigger.
ZH: 一种技术先进的外星武器，而且体型更大。

EN: Whoever built this was not content with vaporising one person at a time.
ZH: 制造它的人，或者生物，显然不满足于一次只让一个目标蒸发。

EN: Now you're loaded for space-bear.
ZH: 现在你准备好了对付太空怪兽了。

EN: This hunk of junk can still bissect a super mutant.
ZH: 这堆破烂仍然可以将变种人拦腰斩断。

EN: This thing will put a hole through power armor at fifty paces.
ZH: 这个东西可以在五十步内打穿动力装甲。

EN: Fully automatic, and perfect for most combat situations.
ZH: 全自动射击，完美适用于大多数战斗情况。

EN: This thing can punch through Power Armor like it's paper.
ZH: 这东西能像穿破纸一样穿破动力装甲。

EN: The kind of gun that wins a soldier the war.
ZH: 那种枪能让士兵在战争中胜利。

EN: Perfect for a merc who wants one gun for any situation, forever.
ZH: 适用于雇佣兵在任何情况下对枪的需要。永远。

EN: Get in, get out, and leave a pile of corpses in your wake.
ZH: 进去，出来，身后留下一堆尸体。

EN: It jams every now and then, but so what? Still great.
ZH: 偶尔会堵塞，但那又怎样呢？还是很强大的。

EN: Decapitation has done little to reduce its deadliness.
ZH: 斩首并没有降低它的致命性。

EN: It has tunnel vision. Tunneling through your enemies vision.
ZH: 它有着隧道视觉——能钻透敌人的视野。

EN: There's getting a little hot headed, then there's this.
ZH: 有的人头脑发热，有的人头脑发光。

EN: A piece of scrap with a mean thousand-yard stare.
ZH: 这块废铁带着凶狠的千码凝视。

EN: The best weapon in the world... for a 10 year-old.
ZH: 世界上最好的武器……如果你只有十岁的话。

EN: Can shoot through a pair of jeans. And maybe even the leg.
ZH: 能射穿一条牛仔裤，甚至射穿腿。

EN: Be careful! This baby may actually break the skin.
ZH: 小心！这个宝贝可能会破坏你的皮肤。

EN: It may not kill your enemy. But it'll sure hurt like heck.
ZH: 它可能不会杀死你的敌人。但它肯定会狠狠伤害。

EN: Powerful enough to shoot a Super Mutant's eye out.
ZH: 强大到足以射穿一个超级变种人的眼睛。

EN: After 20 shots, you just might knock a tin can off the fence.
ZH: 打了二十枪之后，你才能将一个锡罐打下栏杆。

EN: High caliber assault rifle built for troops in power armor.
ZH: 为动力装甲部队打造的大口径突击步枪。

EN: Every spot is a weak spot for this lead spewing beast.
ZH: 对这个子弹喷射猛兽来说，哪里都是弱点！

EN: Fresh out of the BOS armory and ready to spread some order.
ZH: 刚从兄弟会军械库出来，准备传递一点“秩序”。

EN: Battle worn but meticulously maintained weapon for the discerning knight.
ZH: 虽然略有磨损，却维护得无比细致，适合挑剔的骑士。

EN: This monstrous military firearm might need a tuneup, but it's still kicking.
ZH: 这把巨大的军用武器可能需要调试，但它依然威风凛凛。

EN: Enemy head, meet Bat. I'm sure the two of you will hit it off.
ZH: 敌人的头，和棒球棒相遇。我相信你会喜欢它的。

EN: Go mete out some punishment. Get it?
ZH: 去好好教训别人一顿吧。懂我意思吗？

EN: A fully-automatic, drum-loaded shotgun. Ouch.
ZH: 一种全自动筒装的霰弹枪。哎呦喂。

EN: Rumored to be a Ghoul merc's key to the River Styx.
ZH: 据说是一个尸鬼雇佣兵通向冥河的钥匙。

EN: Close-range death dealing... x2. Brutal.
ZH: 近距离死亡威胁……X2。很残忍。

EN: Faster shots, better shells, messier deaths.
ZH: 弹速更快，炮弹更强，死得更惨。

EN: Every pull of the trigger is a kiss of death.
ZH: 每一次扣动扳机，就是一个死亡之吻。

EN: For every misfired shell, there are 5 more that do the job.
ZH: 子弹走火不用急，还有五枚帮助你。

EN: One of the coolest weapons in the wasteland. Everyone will want to chill out with you.
ZH: 废土上最酷的武器之一，所有人都想与你一起冷静下来。

EN: For those that prefer a sleeker, blacker look when gooifying their opponents.
ZH: 专为那些喜欢在把对手化为一滩绿浆时显得更冷峻、更深沉的人士设计。

EN: A hip-slung cannon packing the latest brotherhood upgrades.
ZH: 这把便携加农炮配备了最新的兄弟会升级。

EN: The quickest and cleanest way to a bonus for bringing 'em in alive.
ZH: 取得“活捉”奖金最快、最干净的方法。

EN: A portable nuclear bomb catapult. “Deadly” is an understatement.
ZH: 一种便携式核弹弹射器。“致命”只是轻描淡写。

EN: Some nuclear physicist's pet project. More atoms, bigger boom.
ZH: 某个核物理学家的小项目。意味着更多的原子，更大的爆炸。

EN: Portable nuclear bombs, guided right to their targets. Yes!
ZH: 便携式核弹，准确引导直达目标。一个字，好！

EN: Higher-yield shells for bigger booms... and a bigger body count.
ZH: 更高当量的炮弹带来更大的爆炸……以及更多的阵亡者。

EN: Fires multiple Fat-Man shells. At once. That's a lot of fat.
ZH: 一次性发射多枚“胖子”核弹。可真够“胖”的。

EN: Even old and beat up, this thing can still drop a Radscorpion.
ZH: 即使又破又旧，这东西还是能放倒一只辐射蝎。

EN: Now you can pretend you're a tiny, underpowered Super Mutant Behemoth.
ZH: 现在你可以装作你只是一只弱小的巨兽。

EN: Fry them alive with this combat flamethrower.
ZH: 用战斗型火焰喷射器将他们活活烧死。

EN: Excellent for charring some burgers. Or, say, a Raider compound.
ZH: 做碳烤汉堡的绝佳工具。或者说，烧掉一个掠夺者营地。

EN: Blasts fire farther, hotter and happier than the standard model.
ZH: 比标准款能喷射出更远，更热和更开心的火焰。

EN: Shoots flames as hot as the Hell you send its victims to. Oh, the irony.
ZH: 喷射的火焰如地狱般炙热，把受害者直接送去了地狱。多么讽刺。

EN: It's like wielding the power of a dragon in your arms.
ZH: 这就像在你的手臂上挥舞着一条龙的力量。

EN: Shoots fire a few degrees lower than normal, but still a death dealer.
ZH: 喷射的火焰会比正常型号低几度，但仍然是一个死亡使者。

EN: It's a Minigun. With lasers. 'Nuff said.
ZH: 这是一个旋转机枪。有激光。足够了。

EN: Modded emitters. Faster barrel. Higher ammo capacity. It is ON.
ZH: 改装过的发射器。枪筒更快。载弹量更多。等着瞧吧。

EN: More power in each beam means more pain in every shot!
ZH: 每束光线有更多力量，意味每一次射击有更多痛苦！

EN: One of the laser emitters may misfire occasionally. Big deal.
ZH: 一个激光发射器可能偶尔走火。没什么大不了。

EN: It's like a disco of death, and everyone's invited!
ZH: 像是一个死亡迪斯科，而每个人都被邀请了！

EN: Need revenge? Feeling that furious anger? Oh, are you in for a treat.
ZH: 想要复仇吗？感受到了狂暴的怒火？来吧，这是奖励。

EN: All the magnetic acceleration you can hold in one hand.
ZH: 用一只手能掌握的最大电磁加速力。

EN: A well balanced, well crafted pistol with high quality coils.
ZH: 一把平衡且精致的手枪，配备高质量线圈。

EN: This overcharged pistol is powerful, but of dubious reliability.
ZH: 这把过度充能手枪威力强大，但并不一定可靠。

EN: Modified to drive a heavier projectile, this gun packs a wallop.
ZH: 为了发射更重的弹药而改造，威力十足。

EN: Corroded or not, the coils still do their job.
ZH: 无论线圈是否被腐蚀，它仍能正常工作。

EN: Shoots a magnetically accelerated projectile. Fast.
ZH: 发射磁加速炮弹。快。

EN: Wait, the projectile can go... even faster? You have no idea.
ZH: 等等，炮弹可以……更快吗？不知道。

EN: Someone intensified the magnetic field. You know what that means...
ZH: 有人加强了磁场。你知道那意味着什么……

EN: Out of the R&D lab and in the field, this thing is even more deadly.
ZH: 出了研发实验室而在实地演练，这会更致命。

EN: Magnets + Science! = killing just about anything. No really, anything.
ZH: 磁铁+科学！=几乎杀死任何东西。不是几乎，是真的任何东西。

EN: Time has dulled its shine, but not its effectiveness.
ZH: 时间磨灭了它的光泽，但没有降低它的威力。

EN: This sizeable sidearm serves as a fine companion piece to the Mare's Leg.
ZH: 这把大号手枪是马腿的最佳拍档。

EN: As seen in Grognak the Barbarian #23 "In the Lair of the Virgin Eater."
ZH: 出自《野蛮人古古那》第23期“处女吞噬者的巢穴”。

EN: A reinforced beast with a reinforced bite.
ZH: 加固的猛兽，更强的威力。

EN: A rugged piece for the peaceful at heart.
ZH: 坚固耐用，适合心地善良的人。

EN: Great for taking down game - human or animal alike.
ZH: 非常适合猎杀猎物——不管是人还是野兽。

EN: Most people don't hunt Sentry Bots. You're not most people.
ZH: 大多数人不会猎捕铁卫兵。但你不是大多数人。

EN: Want a new Yao Guai wardrobe? This is the rifle for you.
ZH: 想要一个新妖怪熊皮衣柜？用这把枪。

EN: Once, you were the hunted. With this weapon, those days are gone.
ZH: 曾经，你被四处追杀。有了这个，那些日子就是过去时了。

EN: Can put your horse, or a Deathclaw, out of its misery in a second.
ZH: 可以让你的马，或死爪，一秒内摆脱痛苦。

EN: Dirty but dependable, this is a gun you can trust.
ZH: 肮脏但可靠，是你可以信任的枪。

EN: Sleek, portable and powerful.
ZH: 光滑，便携而且强大。

EN: The power of the future in the palm of your hand.
ZH: 未来的力量在你手中。

EN: The latest lethal tech from the Advanced Systems division.
ZH: 来自高级系统部门的最新致命技术。

EN: Open fire on the Institute's enemies. Literally.
ZH: 向学院的敌人们开火。字面意义上的。

EN: Why settle for vaporizing only one enemy at a time?
ZH: 为什么满足于一次只蒸发一个敌人？

EN: Every great strategy starts with a clear vision.
ZH: 每一个伟大的策略都始于清晰的视野。

EN: Show them you mean business. Institute business.
ZH: 向他们展示你的本事。学院的本事。

EN: There's a particle party in that power core.
ZH: 在力量的核心有一个粒子派对。

EN: The Institute's reach is long, indeed. Now yours is, too.
ZH: 学院的触角伸得很长。现在你的也是。

EN: Your enemies have nowhere left to hide.
ZH: 让你的敌人无处可躲。

EN: Locked-on and loaded.
ZH: 锁定然后上膛。

EN: He's had lots of free time to design this lethal laser.
ZH: 他有大量的空闲时间来设计这种致命的激光。

EN: You'd be surprised how deadly high-speed junk can be.
ZH: 你会惊讶于高速喷射杂物如何的致命。

EN: Death by junk was never so shocking.
ZH: 你一定不知道杂物致死如此令人震惊。

EN: What's scarier than a lethal teddy bear? A flaming teddy bear!
ZH: 有什么比一个致命的泰迪熊更可怕？一只熊熊燃烧的泰迪熊！

EN: Stand rock steady while you blast the bad guys.
ZH: 当你喷射这个坏家伙时，请站稳了。

EN: The latest in portable power and precision.
ZH: 在便携式电源和精度上的最新款。

EN: They'll never make fun of a science nerd again.
ZH: 他们再不会取笑一个科学呆子了。

EN: Rendered deadly from decades of trauma and vindictiveness.
ZH: 历经数十年的创伤与复仇执念，让这把枪变得致命无比。

EN: Ideal for backstabbing. Frontstabbing too. Any stabbing, really.
ZH: 背后捅刀子的理想之选，前面捅刀子也行，真的，适用于任何捅刀子。

EN: Revolutionary style meets high-tech power.
ZH: 革命式的模型遇上高科技能力。

EN: The power of a laser in the palm of your hand. Pew pew!
ZH: 激光力量在你手中。咻咻！

EN: A quick draw, a flash of light, and all that's left is a pile of ash.
ZH: 快速发射，一道闪光，剩下一堆灰烬。

EN: The ultimate sci-fi sidearm. The power of disintegration on your hip.
ZH: 终极科幻武器。腰上架着让人分崩离析的力量。

EN: It can light a cigarette and maybe kill a Radroach.
ZH: 它可以点燃一支烟，或者杀死一只辐射蟑螂。

EN: From dusty cantinas to the end of the line, a true anti-hero's weapon.
ZH: 从尘土飞扬的小酒馆一路干到穷途末路，真正反英雄的武器。

EN: Time to live out all your space cowboy fantasies.
ZH: 是时候活出你所有的太空牛仔幻想了。

EN: A high-tech infantry weapon, used by soldiers before the Great War.
ZH: 一种高技术的步兵武器，在战前被士兵使用。

EN: If you don't disintegrate your target, you're trying to miss.
ZH: 要是没能把目标分解，那说明你是故意射偏的。

EN: The perfect weapon for a high-tech Wasteland warrior.
ZH: 一个高技术废土战士的完美武器。

EN: Dinged up and dirty, but just as powerful as ever.
ZH: 凹凸不平而且脏兮兮的，但还是一如既往的强大。

EN: The laser emitter has been specially tweaked for maximum damage.
ZH: 调整了激光发射器，为了最大的杀伤力。

EN: Biwwy says you'we handy with a weapon. He's got that wight.
ZH: 比依说你很会使武器。他说得没错。

EN: When you need to take down your enemies, cowboy style.
ZH: 像牛仔一样放倒你的敌人。

EN: With this beauty, they may as well not even be wearing armor.
ZH: 有了这个宝贝，他们就算穿了装甲也等于没穿。

EN: A little extra oil in the lever, some fresh rounds. It's killin' time.
ZH: 在杠杆上上点油，装一些新发子弹。现在是杀戮时间。

EN: Take down those black hats like a legend of the Old West.
ZH: 像旧西部传奇一样放倒那些坏蛋。

EN: Looks like an antique, but don't let Old Longfellow hear you say that.
ZH: 看上去像是个古董，但别让老费朗罗听到你这么说。

EN: Abe himself used this to kill Radscorpions. Honest.
ZH: 林肯本人用这枪杀过辐射蝎。真心话。

EN: The lever sticks a bit, but it's still a solid long-range weapon.
ZH: 杠杆不太灵活，但仍然是一把坚固的远程武器。

EN: A favorite of pre-war cops and Wasteland warriors.
ZH: 战前警察和废土战士最喜欢的类型。

EN: Want to blow away a Metal Armored merc at 300 yards? Have fun.
ZH: 想要将穿金属装甲的雇佣兵爆到300码那么远吗？试试看。

EN: Blow a Behemoth's head off from half a Wasteland away.
ZH: 将一只变种人巨兽的脑袋射到半个废土那么远。

EN: All it takes is a better scope and you're blasting baddies like a champ.
ZH: 只要换上更好的瞄准镜，你就能像冠军一样横扫那些坏蛋。

EN: They don't call it a hand cannon for nothin'.
ZH: 他们可不是随便就叫它“手炮”的。

EN: Packs a softer punch, but still a reliable handgun.
ZH: 威力稍弱，但仍是可靠的手枪。

EN: Big bore bang in a compact package.
ZH: 大口径、小体积，震撼来袭！

EN: Shred your enemies in a hail of bullets.
ZH: 在子弹冰雹中瞬间撕碎你的敌人。
